name: TLS/SSL Assessment
description: Assessment of TLS/SSL protocol configurations and implementations. Covers protocol version evaluation, cipher suite selection, handshake analysis, known protocol attacks (BEAST, POODLE, DROWN, ROBOT), client authentication, and TLS 1.3 deployment review.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands TLS fundamentals and why protocol version and cipher suite matter
evidence: Can explain the TLS handshake at a high level
Understands why SSLv3 and TLS 1.0/1.1 are deprecated
Can describe the improvements in TLS 1.3 over TLS 1.2
Knows historical TLS attacks (BEAST, POODLE) and their mitigations

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Runs TLS scanning tools and identifies basic misconfigurations under supervision
evidence: Uses testssl.sh, sslyze, or Nmap to scan TLS configurations
Identifies deprecated protocol versions and weak cipher suites under guidance
Interprets tool output to determine certificate chain and protocol support
Documents TLS findings following lab templates

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses TLS deployments and identifies protocol-level vulnerabilities
evidence: Evaluates cipher suite ordering and identifies insecure preferences
Tests for known TLS attacks (ROBOT, Raccoon, Lucky13, DROWN, Heartbleed, CRIME)
Assesses TLS 1.3 deployments for correct configuration and 0-RTT risks
Produces compliant findings referencing NIST SP 800-52 Rev. 2, RFC 8446, or Mozilla TLS guidance

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex TLS assessment scenarios; analyses custom TLS implementations
evidence: Analyses TLS implementations in non-standard contexts (IoT, embedded, custom protocols)
Evaluates mutual TLS (mTLS) deployments for client certificate validation correctness
Performs TLS traffic analysis and handshake debugging using Wireshark
Reviews and mentors junior staff on TLS assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines TLS assessment methodology; recognised authority on transport layer security
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's TLS assessment methodology and cipher suite recommendations
Published research on TLS vulnerabilities or novel downgrade attacks
Provides expert guidance on TLS deployment strategies and protocol migration
Trains teams on TLS internals, state machine, and assessment approaches

assessment_methods.description: Perform a comprehensive TLS assessment of a multi-service environment: evaluate protocol versions, cipher suites, certificates, and known vulnerabilities
Review TLS assessment findings from a recent engagement for completeness, accuracy, and appropriate severity ratings
